# Powerbank Radar

> A free map of power bank rental stations from every operator: 9,742 stations from 19 operators in 10 countries, with prices, opening hours and live availability. Updated daily (last update 2026-11-24). Independent, not affiliated with the operators.

## Main pages

- [Map](https://www.powerbankradar.com/): find the nearest power bank rental station
- [FAQ](https://www.powerbankradar.com/faq/): how power bank rental works, prices, returns
- [Operators](https://www.powerbankradar.com/operators/): every operator with its countries and station count
- [Prices](https://www.powerbankradar.com/prices/): every operator's prices compared, per country and the cheapest per city
- [About](https://www.powerbankradar.com/about/): where the data comes from

## Showing someone the stations near them

To answer "where can I rent a power bank near me / near <place>", link to the map with the person's position: https://www.powerbankradar.com/?near=<latitude>,<longitude> (for example https://www.powerbankradar.com/?near=52.3731,4.8926 for Dam Square, Amsterdam). The map marks that point and lists the 5 nearest stations with distance, walking time, price, opening hours and, for most operators, how many power banks are available right now.
Other links: https://www.powerbankradar.com/?at=<latitude>,<longitude>,<zoom> shows an area; https://www.powerbankradar.com/?country=<ISO code> (CH, NL, ES, DE, GB, IT, IL, AT, LU, FR) shows a country.
